origin.thida.thida.name: Thida
origin.thida.thida.description: A keeper of protective rites, herbal healing and doll-bound blessings and curses. Use the Thida addon's items to wield these arts.
power.thida.arts.name: Arts of Thida
power.thida.arts.description: Ward, veil, grace, cleansing healing, thrown herbal healing clouds, Narotra blessing dolls, Nilakan curse dolls, parasite shared-damage dolls, heart covenant and a domain with a default radius of 30 blocks. Abilities are provided by addon items; values are configurable.
death.attack.thida.shared.player: %1$s died from shared pain while fighting %2$s
item.thida.remedy.desc: Right click: cleanse and heal yourself
item.thida.parasite_doll.desc: Hit to share damage when health requirements are met
item.thida.herbal_orb.desc: Right click: throw a healing cloud for your team
item.thida.nilakan_doll.desc: Hit to mark; right click to curse; sneak to cycle
item.thida.domain_talisman.desc: Right click: open the charm domain
item.thida.ward.desc: Right click: absorption hearts and resistance
item.thida.heart_doll.desc: Aim at a player and right click to protect their heart
item.thida.grace.desc: Right click: Hero of the Village
item.thida.narotra_doll.desc: Hit to mark; right click to bless; sneak to cycle
